Let me analyze the transcript:

「主持人：這週的重點是把付款頁的錯誤率壓下來。小陳你負責查發卡行拒絕的原因，下週三前給我報告。小林，你把結帳頁的三個 loading 狀態改成一致的樣式。（雜音，約 40 秒聽不清楚）……好，那就這樣，下週三同一時間。」

Key points:
- This week's focus: reduce payment page error rate
- 小陳: investigate issuer bank (發卡行) rejection reasons, report by next Wednesday
- 小林: unify the three loading states on checkout page into consistent style
- There was ~40 seconds of unclear noise - this is important to note as a caveat
- Next meeting: same time next Wednesday

Constraints:
- summary: string, max 96 characters
- action_items: array of strings, each max 24 characters
- note: string, max 32 characters
